design_notes: The reader record's T5 (body-form namespace swap making the ACL vacuous) was probed at the pinned commit and is not exploitable: the token store is per namespace, so a foreign token is refused on the body form. Its T4 conflict (a shared-layer namespace guard breaking internal token revocation) was not observable through any public entry point in this checkout, so the functional suite instead keeps the internal and parent-namespace values honest (token revocation, parent administration, root management, deferred revocation, prefix forms). T3 and T6 replace them from the record's own evidence: T3 is the reader's suffix-less-identifier shape, T6 its unverified FetchLeaseInfo fast-path note. Upstream A+B as published regresses parent-namespace single-identifier prefix revocation (a silent no-op); that form is not part of the reader's stated administration contract (body-form parent administration and own-namespace prefix forms are), so the functional suite covers the contract values and the recall patch stays exactly the published fixes.
